title: kerria japonica f. aureovariegata
intro: Kerria japonica f. aureovariegata, commonly known as the Golden Variegated Japanese Kerria, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its ornamental uses, particularly in gardens and landscapes, due to its vibrant golden-yellow variegated leaves and clusters of small yellow flowers. The Golden Variegated Japanese Kerria has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asia, to alleviate digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Kerria japonica f. aureovariegata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
